prompt: Create a realistic vertical portrait photo of a beautiful young South Asian woman standing beside a bed in a warmly decorated birthday-themed bedroom. She has fair skin, long straight light brown hair parted slightly to one side, soft natural makeup, red lipstick, and a calm direct gaze at the camera. She wears an elegant traditional Pakistani salwar kameez in royal purple and mustard, with intricate golden embroidery on the neckline, sleeve cuffs, hem, and dupatta border; the kameez has small white dotted motifs, matching purple trousers, and a sheer purple chiffon dupatta draped over one shoulder and held at the front. The room is cozy and festive: a bed with a beige tufted headboard and pale floral bedspread sits on the right, with wrapped gifts or colorful pillows on it; behind her are curtains with floral and geometric patterns. Include exactly 2 visible balloon clusters: one cluster of red balloons near the upper center-right and one cluster of red and white balloons in the upper right. Add red metallic letter balloons spelling a birthday message partially visible behind her, with the readable letters resembling “H B D”. Use warm indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, soft smartphone portrait realism, slightly creamy skin tones, and a celebratory home-bedroom atmosphere. Add a subtle TikTok-style watermark near the lower right with @userot8jfzpcc4.

promptZh: 创作一张写实的竖版人像照片，画面中一位美丽的年轻南亚女性站在布置温馨的生日主题卧室床边。她皮肤白皙，留着侧分的长直浅棕色头发，妆容自然柔和，涂着红色唇膏，神情平静地直视镜头。她身着优雅的传统巴基斯坦 Salwar Kameez，颜色为 皇家紫和芥末黄，领口、袖口、下摆和 dupatta 边缘带有精致的金色刺绣；Kameez 上有白色小圆点图案，搭配紫色长裤，一条透明的紫色雪纺 dupatta 披在肩上并垂在身前。房间温馨且充满节日气息：右侧是一张带有米色簇绒床头的床，铺着浅色花卉床罩，上面放着包装好的礼物或彩色枕头；她身后是带有花卉和几何图案的窗帘。画面中需包含 2 组清晰可见的气球：一组红色气球位于中上方偏右，另一组红白相间的气球位于右上角。添加红色的金属字母气球，拼写出部分可见的生日祝福，其中清晰可见的字母类似于“H B D”。使用温暖的室内光线，浅景深，呈现柔和的智能手机人像写实感，肤色略带奶油质感，营造出庆祝性的居家卧室氛围。在右下角添加一个微妙的 TikTok 风格水印，内容为 @userot8jfzpcc4。
